name: mc_inspect
title: Inspect blocks
description:
Reads exact block data from the world: a block-frequency table, an ASCII cross-section, or per-column block runs.

Default output: every distinct state in the box by count and percentage, plus its bounds (e.g. "is there leftover scaffolding?"). With `slice`: one 2D layer or cut as an ASCII grid with a legend and coordinate ruler (grids over 80x60 are downsampled to the most common block per character, as noted). With format "columns" (not with slice): exact bottom-to-top runs per column, to repair a hole, crater or wall gap in one call. With format "exterior" (not with slice): what the finished build shows outside - blocks next to air reached from the box's sides or top, by material - plus sealed air and detached pieces not connected to the bottom layer (stray blocks, leftover scaffolding); leave a one-block air margin around the build, with the bottom layer in the ground; an open doorway lets outside air in, so interior faces then count too. For a picture of a layer, use mc_render view "slice".

WHEN TO USE: after mc_build when build feedback raises a specific doubt; to read existing structures or terrain in detail (mc_survey reads only the surface).
WHEN NOT TO USE: to find ground level over a large area (mc_survey); to place blocks (mc_build).

COORDINATES: X east, Z south, Y up; from/to inclusive corners in any order; at most 200,000 blocks.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only.

world.description: World name; default: the configured default world.

format.description: "stats" (default); "columns": one line per column, "x,z: y1-y2 block | y3-y4 block | ...", at most 1,024 columns; "exterior": outside surface by material, sealed air and detached pieces. Not with slice.

slice.description: One 2D cross-section as an ASCII grid instead of the table.

axis.description: "y": a horizontal layer; "x"/"z": a vertical cross-section.

entities.description: Also list paintings, item frames and armor stands in the box (type, position, facing, variant/item/equipment; [Ashlar] marks Ashlar-placed ones).

canonical.description: Default true: drop default-valued properties and the minecraft: prefix. false shows full server states.
